normalization_plan.reason: Sender parameter only influences the core transfer routine's bot/cooldown/pair checks.
Recipient parameter only influences the core transfer routine's cooldown and pair checks.
Amount parameter is only validated and consumed by the core transfer routine.
tokenAmount parameter exists solely to size the router swap call.
Blacklist array parameter is only iterated by the core setBots setter.
Address parameter is only used to clear a blacklist entry.
Local balance snapshot is only used to size the swap invocation.
Local rate cache is only derived from the core rate computation.
